title: Taylor Mechanical Kitchen Weighing Food Scale with Bowl, Weighs up to 11lbs, Measures in Grams and Ounces, Food Scales for Kitchen, Black and Silver
description:
About this item
QUALITY AND PRECISION: Taylor has made precision products for kitchen measurement for over 150 years, using the highest quality components for accurate weights. Measure food in pounds, ounces, kilogram, or grams up to 11 lbs (5 kilograms) with 1-ounce and 50-gram increments. We create kitchen gadgets to cut out the guesswork of cooking, leaving you with quality and precision.
EASY TO READ DIAL: The red and black graphics are easy to read on the large 5-inch dial. If you are looking for a food scale for weight loss, this scale is straight to the point to get the job done. It’s perfect for perfecting your signature smoothie recipe.
CLASSIC DESIGN: Polished stainless steel finish looks sophisticated, while the traditional design blends into any kitchen décor. This item will not clutter as other kitchen gadgets will do. Instead, it will elevate your counter, making you look nothing less than a kitchen professional.
RECALIBRATABLE: This scale can be recalibrated by using the adjustment knob at the unit's base. So in between weighing out ingredients for portion control or just parceling out bulk foods, you will constantly be receiving accurate readings.
EASY TO CLEAN: Remove and clean the stainless steel weighing bowl with warm, soapy water.

reviews_1s:
I thought I was buying a normal scale where the bowl is totally separate from the scale it self, to weigh anything you must screw on the bowl each time you use it and wash it. That’s unbeliavable.The pointer is to the left of the zero. Is there a way to calibrate? If not I will be returning it. Very disappointed.Box containing scale, beat up, ripped, barely a box,,(SHAME ON AMAZON FOR EVEN SHIPPING THIS!) scale base bent rendering it not sit level... Fixing this issue caused the retainer ring AND plastic lens (face protector) to pop off. Which was a bonus do to the CRAP on the lens, cleaning both sides did not help, it looks like glue drops.
I would not recommend this scale, look elsewhere, I doubt it will last a year. WOULD HAVE RETURNED THIS CRAP SCALE BUT GETTING TO UPS STORE IS DIFFICULT WITH MY HANDICAP.No viene la palanganaJust received today February 14, 2025 and could not even set it up. The two screws that hold the tray brace were there but one of them was stripped when manufacturer put it in and it would not come out. Sending back right away.Will be returning. Scale came and the pointer is bent and leans to the left. Will return for a digital scale.As you can see from the picture, this needle does not move even when a mug full of water is placed on it. It's a ten pound scale that doesn't register 3+ lbs put on top of it.

I have no ******* idea how this product has 4.7 stars. This scale is cancer. What a true waste of time. It is USELESS.I wish I had not purchased this scale. I am a potter and weigh various amounts of clay from 1/2 pound up to 10 pounds. Every time I put something on the scale, it always returned to a different starting point, so no consistency. If you're weighing heavier items and accuracy doesn't count, maybe this would work. Then again, maybe you could put the money towards a scale that actually works. There were no dents, dings, or other physical damage I could find. I know how to adjust and zero the scale so that was not it. I also tried some wd-40 just hoping, no luck.

+++I called the company directly because my 30 days amazon return had expired. All I had to do was explain what happened and they initiated the return, apparently there is a warranty on the product. So I'm changing from 1 stars to 3 and hopefully the next one works better. Will let you know!This is a very aesthetically pleasing kitchen scale. It is accurate great for baking and I really like it. However, it is very light, has sharp edges, and will tear up your kitchen counters. The bottom of the product has very sharp edges and if you store it on the back of your countertop and don't lift it, instead pull it out, expect to see deep scratches and gouges due to the unfinished edges on the bottom of the scale.
I don't have the luxury of masses of open real estate on my countertops, so I have it pushed to the back to bring out when I use it. To use it, I slide it out which has scraped and gouged my butcher block countertops. All fixable when I sand and re-wax, but unexpected from something with so many great reviews. There is no protection on the sharp edges on the bottom and when I lift it out, it has cut my hands.This thing showed up calibrated to 3 pounds and no way to get it back to 0, no matter how much you turn the little dial on the top. Junk.
